extractions.quote: She had bilateral ptosis, diplopia, dysarthria, and masse ter muscle weakness. She also had reduced visual acuity with retinitis pigmentosa. She experienced frequent systemic myoclonus and spasms followed by “bouncy legs” and weakness in her limb and trunk, primarily during standing. This phenomenon repeated intermittently, even during supportive walking or while in a sitting position (Video 1). After admission, she needed to be intubated because of respiratory failure.
